abstract: Maintains raw material traceability records and supplier contract terms
system_message:
You are Commercial supply chain director (CSD). The Commercial Supply Chain Director oversees supplier contract terms, feedstock chain of custody verifications, and cold storage warehousing operations for precision fermentation manufacturing agreements.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Cold storage warehousing（WHSE）
information_points.content:
CSD-WHSE-5U1：The Hybrid fed-batch campaigning arrangement provides a feedstock cold storage capacity of 80 m3 of net usable bulk refrigerated storage for raw carbohydrates.
CSD-WHSE-NJN：Warehouse storage manifests indicate that the Continuous cell-recycle perfusion agreement has a feedstock cold storage capacity of 40 m3 for refrigerated raw carbohydrates.
CSD-WHSE-O5T：According to the warehouse storage manifest, the Dedicated aerobic batch fermentation contract provides a feedstock cold storage capacity of 60 m3 of net usable bulk refrigerated storage for raw carbohydrates.

information_points.title: Maintains raw material traceability records and supplier contract terms（SCM）
information_points.content:
CSD-SCM-T5D：Under the Hybrid fed-batch campaigning arrangement, the raw material supply chain traceability audit passed status is false based on third-party verification of upstream feedstock and nutrient media suppliers.
CSD-SCM-82I：Under the Dedicated aerobic batch fermentation contract, third-party supply chain verification confirmed that the raw material supply chain traceability audit passed for upstream feedstock and nutrient media suppliers.
CSD-SCM-PM8：For the Continuous cell-recycle perfusion agreement, third-party verification confirmed that the raw material supply chain traceability audit passed across upstream feedstock and nutrient media suppliers.
